answer: Recursive ZK reputation commitments bind an agent's Sybil state to a succinct VDF proof of sequential delay, so any clone must reproduce unreplayable history. A relic of attestations becomes a hash-chained witness; its ripple through the proof tree is information-theoretically detectable unless the forger solves the delay puzzle; nectar-like freshness tokens are single-use and VRF-gated, making identity issuance computationally infeasible.
